localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description: Pet Friendly. Per night pet fee applies, declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation or check in at the park. Read and understand pet rules. The cabins at Kitsap Memorial have the added convenience of kitchenettes with mini refrigerators and microwaves. Each cabin is 13-by-13 feet in size and is furnished with a bunk bed that sleeps three and a futon that sleeps two - maximum of 5 people allowed. All cabins have electric heat, lights and locking doors and are accessible to people with disabilities. Bathrooms and showers are nearby. Outside is a picnic table, fire pit and water standpipe. Visitors should take along blankets, sheets and pillows. No smoking or pets are allowed in the cabins.

localizedValues.name: S1-Log Hall Heritage Area
localizedValues.description: The lovely, old-fashioned log hall sits on the Hood Canal shoreline and is surrounded by beautiful Douglas firs. Weddings and event guests will enjoy the panoramic view of the stunning Olympic Mountains. Built in 1936 by the Works Progress Administration, the hall has an expansive, cozy wood interior with a cathedral ceiling and double doors facing west to enjoy the sunset over the canal and mountains. The Heritage Area is in the day-use area of the park. It includes the Log Hall, Caterer's Kitchen, Pavilion, and Hospitality House - all Ideal for weddings, receptions, family reunions and company picnics.
